messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired for service `inference-gateway` (High). Incident: https://pagerduty.example/incidents/P12345 — 5xx spike across EU-West, started ~03:08 UTC. Trigger: 5xx-rate > 4% for 2m.

maria: acked on PD at 03:09 UTC — I'm taking first look. :phone:

pagerduty-bot: ACK recorded: maria. If no ack within 2m escalation to `oncall-secondary`.

alex: seeing a ~15% increase in 502/503s on the /v1/generate endpoint in eu-west-1. Dumping recent ingress errors now.

jon: any recent deploys? I can check k8s events.

maria: there was a model-serving rollout to `model-serving-v2` 28m ago. No config changes to gateway.

ops-night: I can't get into the prod logs UI from my location, can someone paste the top error lines?

alex: pasting relevant tail:
```
ERROR inference-gateway: upstream timeout (code 504) for request id=f3a9...
ERROR model-proxy: conn reset by peer while sending request to pod model-serving-v2-7bf9
```

maria: I ran `kubectl get pods -n prod -l app=model-serving` — a few pods for v2 are in CrashLoopBackOff. Suspect memory/oom spike after rollout.

sre-lead: reminder: escalation policy will page secondary after 2 mins unacked. maria acknowledged so no auto-escalation expected. keep us posted.

incident-bot: PagerDuty note: next escalation window at 03:11 UTC if unacked.

(03:11 UTC) pagerduty-bot: Escalation: primary on-call did not acknowledge the follow-up notification; paging `oncall-secondary`. :alarm_clock:

oncall-manager: I got paged as secondary — jumping in. Who is on the cluster?

maria: still here. initial hypothesis: v2 pods crashing causing upstream circuit-breakers in gateway. customer-facing errors primarily for EU-West; traffic still flowing to older model-serving-v1 in other regions.

oncall-manager: copy. Can we rollback the v2 deployment or scale it down to mitigate?

alex: preparing rollback now. command we'll run:
```
kubectl rollout undo deploy/model-serving -n prod --to-revision=123
kubectl scale deploy/model-serving-v2 -n prod --replicas=0
```

maria: rolling back v2 to v1 revision 123. doing a `kubectl rollout status` and monitoring logs.

(03:15 UTC) incident-bot: PagerDuty: follow-up notification unacknowledged from oncall-secondary; escalating to `manager-pager` per policy.

jon: manager page went out — looks like PD escalated after secondary couldn't confirm mitigation; network was flaky for them.

oncall-manager: I saw the page, joining. If rollback completes we should see errors drop in ~30s. Also bumping replicas for the gateway to absorb retries: `kubectl scale deploy/inference-gateway -n prod --replicas=6`.

alex: rollback finished at 03:18 UTC; scaling gateway to 6 replicas now.

maria: logs show 502s falling — previous circuit resets are gone. GA requests in eu-west are returning 200s again.

ops-night: Can confirm from synthetic monitors: error rate dropped from 12% -> 0.8% in 2m window.

maria: pushing a temporary routing rule to direct EU-West traffic away from problematic nodes while we verify.

non-technical-note: customer impact — partial: some customers on EU-West saw degraded throughput and failed requests between 03:08–03:18 UTC. No data leak, just transient errors. Notifying support channel to prepare comms.

sre-lead: good mitigation. Let's keep the incident open for postmortem and full RCA. Assigning postmortem owner: maria.

maria: will create postmortem and include timeline, pagerduty escalation chain, root cause (v2 memory regression), rollout checks we missed, and follow-ups:
- add pre-rollout canary for memory usage
- tighten health check thresholds to fail fast
- add automated rollback if crashloop > 1m

oncall-manager: thumbs up. Also add PD policy tweak: if secondary doesn't ack within 90s escalate to manager and include SMS fallback for the secondary. We hit a case where they didn't receive the follow-up due to mobile DND.

incident-bot: Incident update logged: mitigation successful, error rate recovered. Incident will remain open for RCA.

maria: handing off monitoring to ops-night for next 30m while I write the postmortem draft. ops-night, can you watch for regressions and keep this thread updated?

ops-night: on it. will ping here for any blips.

jon: quick note — ticket created PD-7624 and internal incident tracker Link: https://redwood.example/incidents/PD-7624

maria: thanks everyone. follow-up action items in the postmortem: runbook updates for rollbacks, PD escalation timing changes, and a perf test for model-serving-v2 before next rollout.

sre-lead: great response. we'll do a retro in tomorrow's SRE weekly. closing notes in a bit after postmortem created. :thumbsup:
